targets.title: The presence of variety reduces perceived quantity.
targets.evidence_quote: Across three consecutive years (2012 to 2014), we conducted six replications of the studies reported by Redden and Hoch (2009).
targets.outcome_quote: In six different studies, we failed to replicate the effect that variety reduces perceived quantity.
